matchupOfTheWeek.title: Rush Offense vs. Run Defense
matchupOfTheWeek.description: Our rush offense grades in the 65th percentile against a unit that grades 6th — the widest real statistical edge on the board this week.

previewTake: Here's the thing about this matchup: we've got the widest statistical edge on the board this week, and it happens to be exactly where we need it. Our rush offense is grading in the 65th percentile against Buffalo's run defense, which sits at 6th — that's a chasm, and in a game where we're 7-point underdogs, controlling the line of scrimmage feels like the blueprint. The Bills' offense is genuinely elite (2nd in EPA efficiency), so we can't play a shoot-out, but their defense ranks 24th — there's real vulnerability there if we can sustain drives. The recent head-to-head splits are humbling (we're 2-3 in the last five), and Buffalo's been slightly sharper than us the last three weeks (0.14 EPA/play to our -0.11), but when you've got this kind of schematic advantage up front and a plus-7 line, you have to trust the film. This is a game we can win if we run the ball, stay patient, and let our one clear edge do the work.
